skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Summer Flowers FA018
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA018. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
skins.quote: There's no clash at all between studying volcanoes and a love of playing in the water.

skins.name: Fluffy Little Witch
skins.content: Brand Collaborative Series/Fluffy Little Witch. Perhaps every girl has dreamed of it—raising a parasol, donning a top hat, letting her magic dance across the night sky. She tells her fluffy friends the moment for dreams to come true is here.
skins.quote: Tonight, let all the complex investigation reports and lengthy monitoring records stay far away from her. Let her embrace her childlike nature and roam among the bright lights with her cute fluffy friends. This is the gift she deserves.
